title: Power Integrity Intern Worker
description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
As a Physical Design Engineering Undergraduate Intern, you will contribute to the physical implementation of platform designs to ensure readiness for manufacturing. For this role the candidate would support Power Integrity engineers in electrical design and validation activities for Client, Edge and Physical AI platforms, you will be working on design, deploy, and optimize high-speed interconnect architecture. This role offers hands-on experience in physical design flow
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications :
Minimum qualifications are required to be initially considered for this position.
Must be pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Electronics or Electrical Engineering, with at least 50 percent of courses completed, OR a Master's degree in the same field.
For Bachelor's candidates, 0-1 years of hands-on experience in physical design, gained through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands-on training. Master's candidates require no prior professional experience.
Proficiency in English (written and verbal).
Completion of at least 1-2 courses in Electrical/Electromagnetic fundamentals.
Availability to work at least 22.5 hours per week during the internship period.
Maintain a minimum of 80 percent GPA.
Legal authorization to work in Costa Rica.
Preferred Qualifications:
Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.
Knowledge of electrical simulation tools such as Sigrity PowerSI, SiWave, Hspice, Matlab, or Ansys HFSS.
Familiarity with PCB design and circuit simulators.
Experience with statistical analysis tools such as JMP.
Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset, with a passion for solving technical challenges.
Explore your potential in a dynamic and innovative environment-apply today to contribute to groundbreaking technology at Intel.
Job Type:
Student / Intern
Shift:
Shift 1 (Costa Rica)

Costa Rica, San Jose
